claims.text: Deep cryogenic treatment can be used as a post-build treatment for additively manufactured high-entropy alloys.
The deep cryogenic treatment should be performed immediately or shortly after additive manufacturing.
Deep cryogenic treatment relieves residual stresses in additively manufactured HEA components.
Deep cryogenic treatment refines the grain structure of additively manufactured HEA components.
Deep cryogenic treatment reduces dislocation density in additively manufactured HEA components.
Deep cryogenic treatment reduces microstructural inhomogeneity in additively manufactured HEA components.
Deep cryogenic treatment induces uniform contraction throughout the material.
Uniform contraction during deep cryogenic treatment relieves residual stresses.
Deep cryogenic treatment produces a more homogeneous phase distribution.
Residual-stress relief and microstructural refinement improve dimensional precision.
Deep cryogenic treatment improves the mechanical integrity of additively manufactured HEA components.
Relative to the untreated as-deposited baseline, deep cryogenic treatment can increase tensile strength.
Relative to the untreated as-deposited baseline, deep cryogenic treatment can increase ductility.
Mechanical properties such as strength and ductility may improve by approximately 10–25% relative to untreated additively manufactured components.
Deep cryogenic treatment reduces dimensional deviations in additively manufactured HEA components.
Deep cryogenic treatment lowers the density of fabrication-induced defects.
As-built additively manufactured HEAs typically retain residual stresses, heterogeneous microstructures, and fabrication-induced defects caused by rapid thermal cycling.
A treatment near liquid-nitrogen temperature, approximately -196 °C, is an appropriate deep cryogenic treatment condition.
The proposed effect should apply to HEAs with similar compositions and processing histories but may be limited by extreme changes in composition or processing parameters.
The magnitude of improvement depends on the HEA formulation and the detailed cryogenic-treatment protocol.
